hull_geometry: Large circular primary hull (saucer) connected via a slender dorsal neck to a secondary engineering hull; twin cylindrical warp nacelles extend on pylons
materials_and_finish: Smooth, polished hull with subtle grid lines; the name 'BATTLESHIP' is clearly stenciled in bold black lettering on the dorsal saucer surface
design_philosophy: Balanced power distribution and modular mission pods; emphasizes scientific exploration and defensive versatility
color_scheme: Light beige and off-white hull plating; the nacelle field grills glow with a vibrant blue energy; red navigation lights on the saucer rim
distinctive_traits: Iconic multi-hull configuration with distinct separation between primary and secondary systems
